results.title: Christmas Murder Mystery Party Game for Adults, 6 to 12 Players, Ugly Sweater Party, Printable Whodunit Kit, Host Can Play
results.description:
AT A GLANCE
What: printable Christmas murder mystery party game
For: 6 to 12 adults, and the host can play because nobody knows the killer
Time: about 3 hours with dinner, 2 without
Costume: an ugly Christmas sweater for each character
Files: 2 PDFs, US Letter and A4, 36 pages each, with host guide, 12 characters, 24 secret slips, 9 evidence cards and invitations

One village party, twelve ugly sweaters, one dead Father Christmas, and every sweater is a clue.

It is the Christmas party at Kettlecombe Village Hall: carols, cocoa, mince pies and a raffle. For twenty two years Gordon Pratt has played Father Christmas in the grotto. Tonight he sets his SANTA mug down, leads the carols, comes back at a quarter past nine and drinks. A few minutes later Father Christmas slides off his sleigh chair and does not get up. Snow has closed the lane, and the killer is one of your guests.

THE TWIST: NOBODY KNOWS WHO DID IT
Not the host, not the guests, not even the killer. Every sheet, slip and card is spoiler free and the answer is sealed on the last pages, so the host plays a suspect and solves the case with everyone else.

EVERY UGLY SWEATER IS A CLUE
Each character comes with a Christmas sweater to wear: red with reindeer, navy with lights, white with gingerbread men, green with silver bells. Somewhere in the evidence, one of those sweaters gives the killer away.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Send the invitations and give each guest a character and a sweater.
2. Round One: read the opening aloud and the first three pieces of evidence. Who was in the grotto at 9:04?
3. Round Two: everyone opens a secret, three new clues, alibis hold or crack.
4. Round Three: the darkest secrets and the last evidence.
5. Everyone accuses. Then the sealed Truth is read aloud and scored.

FOR 6 TO 12 PLAYERS
The six key suspects are always played, so the game works with six. Characters seven to twelve join as your guest list grows. About three hours with dinner, two without.

WHAT YOU GET
2 PDF files, US Letter and A4, 36 pages each:
Host guide and a timetable for the night
Opening scene to read aloud, cast list and a plan of the village hall
12 character sheets and 24 secret slips
9 evidence cards with round envelopes
Detective's notebook and accusation slips
Fill in invitations, 12 name badges, 8 menu cards and 6 awards
The sealed Truth, with how to solve it and scoring

THE SUSPECTS
Holly Pratt, the daughter (red, with white reindeer)
Dr. Noel Fairweather, the retired vet (green, snowflakes and silver bells)
Bea Marley, the treasurer (green, silver bells at the cuffs)
Ivy Crumb, the cook (white, with gingerbread men)
Rex Holloway, the developer (navy, with flashing lights)
Elfie Dunn, the elf (green elf sweater with silver bells)
Rev. Gabriel Hart, the vicar (green, silver bells and a star)
Marigold Pratt, the ex-wife (green, holly and silver bells)
Tom Briggs, the farmer (red tartan)
Clara Snow, the soprano (white, with sequins)
Major Percy Plum, the old soldier (green, silver bells and a pudding)
Lottie Gray, the postmistress (red, with white pompoms)

GOOD TO KNOW
This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped. Print at home in color or black and white.
The solution is fair: every clue is in the evidence, and the logic is checked by a program so exactly one suspect fits, at every table size from 6 to 12.
Any sweater in the right color works. Go by the cast list, not by what your friends actually wore.
For your own parties. Please do not share or resell the files.

MADE BY
Clueberry Press, home of The Kettlecombe Murders by Ada Quinn. The text is written with the help of AI and edited by hand. The two photos are made with an AI image generator; the layout is designed by us.

Also in the shop: Murder at the Lantern Ball, our Halloween party game.
